book.title: Crit Hit & Run
invariants: No convenient amnesia as a continuity device.

bridge.to_next: Artie must find a way to survive his first night with zero defensive stats.

chapters.goal: Introduce Artie and his broken 'Crit-Only' status in a high-stakes environment.

sections.end_condition: Artie is locked into a 'Crit or Quit' build with 1 HP and 100% Critical Hit rate.
sections.intent: Establish Artie's mundane life and sudden, absurd death.

scenes.outcome: Artie dies and enters the System's character creation void.
scenes.summary: Artie argues with a vending machine over a bag of chips before a freak electrical surge sends him to the great login screen in the sky.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie stands before the humming vending machine in the breakroom.
scenes.transition_out_text: The world fades to white as the electrical surge consumes the breakroom.

scenes.outcome: Artie realizes he is dead and trapped in a digital purgatory.
scenes.summary: Floating in an endless white void, Artie tries to process his sudden electrocution while a glowing 'Welcome' prompt blinks mockingly in his field of vision.
scenes.transition_in_text: The blinding white light slowly resolves into an endless, featureless expanse.
scenes.transition_out_text: A series of floating blue screens suddenly materialize in the empty space.

scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie is locked into a 'Crit or Quit' build with 1 HP and 100% Critical Hit rate.
scenes.outcome: Artie is locked into a 'Crit or Quit' build with 1 HP and 100% Critical Hit rate.
scenes.summary: The System, personified as a snarky UI named Fizz, mocks Artie's life choices while he accidentally dumps all his points into the 'Crit' stat.
scenes.transition_in_text: The white expanse of the void replaces the smell of ozone.
scenes.transition_out_text: The void dissolves into the pixelated textures of the tutorial zone.

sections.title: The Exit Interview

sections.end_condition: Artie is forced to run for his life as the tutorial zone aggros on him.
sections.intent: Show the immediate danger of a 1 HP build.

scenes.outcome: Artie experiences the physical sensation of his new 1 HP body.
scenes.summary: Artie materializes in the physical world, immediately feeling the terrifying fragility of his 1 HP build as even the wind feels like a threat.
scenes.transition_in_text: The pixelated horizon solidifies into a vibrant, overly green landscape.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie takes a hesitant step, his boots crunching against the low-poly flowers.

scenes.outcome: Artie realizes that in this world, '1 HP' means a stiff breeze could kill him.
scenes.summary: Artie spawns in the middle of a tutorial zone and is immediately targeted by a Level 1 Slime that looks suspiciously aggressive.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie's feet hit the green grass of the Slime Meadow with a soft thud.
scenes.transition_out_text: The slime wobbles forward, its gelatinous body pulsing with intent.

scenes.outcome: Artie gains his first level and realizes his power is terrifyingly inconsistent.
scenes.summary: Artie tries to punch the slime; he misses five times before landing a 'Super-Mega-Ultra-Crit' that vaporizes the slime and the tree behind it.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie squares his shoulders against the wobbling slime.
scenes.transition_out_text: A golden chest drops from the sky with a heavy thud where the slime once stood.

scenes.outcome: Artie is forced to run for his life as the tutorial zone aggros on him.
scenes.summary: The System awards Artie a 'Participation Trophy' item that actually attracts monsters.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie reaches for the trophy, unaware of the red glow it emits.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie sprints toward the distant stone walls of Oakhaven.

scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie is forced to run for his life as the tutorial zone aggros on him.
scenes.outcome: Artie barely outruns the aggroed monsters and reaches the safety of the town gates.
scenes.summary: Clutching his cursed trophy, Artie sprints down the forest path, dodging snapping jaws and low-level wolves until the stone walls of Oakhaven appear.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie's lungs burn as he pounds down the dusty forest path, the growls growing louder behind him.
scenes.transition_out_text: He bursts from the treeline, collapsing near the massive iron-bound gates of the town.

sections.title: The First Spawn

sections.end_condition: Artie makes his first rival and barely escapes a forced duel.
sections.intent: Reach the first hub and establish the world's culture.

scenes.outcome: Artie enters the town but is flagged as a 'Statistical Anomaly' by the gate scanners.
scenes.summary: Artie reaches the gates of Oakhaven, where the guards are busy betting on the 'Crit-Rate' of incoming travelers.
scenes.transition_in_text: The forest path opens up to a set of massive iron-bound gates.
scenes.transition_out_text: The guards usher Artie through the gate, their eyes fixed on his glowing status.

scenes.outcome: Artie navigates the town and finds the local tavern.
scenes.summary: Artie walks through the bustling streets of Oakhaven, trying to ignore his glowing 'Anomaly' status, and heads for the largest tavern to gather information.
scenes.transition_in_text: The heavy gates close behind him, leaving Artie in the middle of a busy cobblestone street.
scenes.transition_out_text: He spots a hanging sign for The Gilded Tankard and pushes his way inside.

scenes.outcome: Artie understands his 'broken' stat makes him a target for the powerful.
scenes.summary: Artie meets the local Mayor/Tavern Keeper, who explains that 'Crits' are the only currency that matters to the local nobility.
scenes.transition_in_text: The heavy oak door of the tavern swings open to a wave of warmth.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie steps out of the tavern into the bright midday sun of the square.

scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie makes his first rival and barely escapes a forced duel.
scenes.outcome: Artie makes his first rival and barely escapes a forced duel.
scenes.summary: A high-level Paladin, Vane, notices Artie's glowing 'Anomaly' aura and decides to 'mentor' him (bully him).
scenes.transition_in_text: Vane's shadow falls over Artie as he crosses the square.

sections.title: The Safe Zone?

chapters.stakes_shift: Artie goes from an office drone to a level 1 glitch in a lethal game world.
chapters.title: Welcome to the RNG-Hellscape

threads.label: The Path of the First Glitch

bridge.from_prev: Artie is a marked man in Oakhaven.
bridge.to_next: Artie heads to the Low-Level Crypts to farm 'Evasion' gear.

chapters.goal: Artie needs gear that doesn't rely on him being hit, as he can't take a single blow.

sections.end_condition: Artie is now slightly harder to hit but looks like a neon yellow cat.
sections.intent: Equip Artie with the bare minimum to survive a dungeon.

scenes.outcome: Artie is stuck with a lighthouse-beacon for monsters.
scenes.summary: Artie tries to sell his 'Participation Trophy' to a skeptical pawnbroker but finds out it's soul-bound and cursed.
scenes.transition_in_text: The bell above the pawn shop door jingles as Artie enters.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie leaves the shop, the trophy still glowing brightly in his pack.

scenes.outcome: Artie avoids the main street to hide his glowing cursed item.
scenes.summary: Artie hurries out of the pawn shop, the cursed trophy pulsing like a beacon in his bag, and ducks into a damp alleyway to avoid the staring townsfolk.
scenes.transition_in_text: The bright glow of the trophy draws immediate stares from passing merchants.
scenes.transition_out_text: Fizz directs him toward a narrow gap between two buildings, leading into the shadows.

scenes.outcome: Artie successfully crits a lock, causing it to explode into gold dust.
scenes.summary: Fizz points out a loophole in the 'Starter Pack' quest that allows Artie to steal a high-tier cloak if he can crit a lock.
scenes.transition_in_text: Fizz leads Artie into the shadows behind the general store.
scenes.transition_out_text: The explosion of the lock leaves a single item floating in the air.

scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie is now slightly harder to hit but looks like a neon yellow cat.
scenes.outcome: Artie is now slightly harder to hit but looks like a neon yellow cat.
scenes.summary: Artie acquires the 'Cloak of the Cowardly Lion,' which gives +50 Evasion but -100 Dignity.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie pulls the neon yellow cloak over his shoulders.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie heads toward the outskirts of town, avoiding eye contact with everyone.

sections.title: Shopping for Scraps

sections.end_condition: Artie discovers he can farm resources much faster than anyone else.
sections.intent: Test the new gear and the Crit-build in a controlled environment.

scenes.outcome: Artie reaches the crypts without being spotted by guards.
scenes.summary: Wearing his embarrassing new neon yellow cloak, Artie sneaks through the outskirts of Oakhaven, avoiding the main roads until he reaches the overgrown entrance to the Low-Level Crypts.
scenes.transition_in_text: The neon yellow fabric of his new cloak makes sneaking nearly impossible, drawing confused looks from stray dogs.
scenes.transition_out_text: He finally spots the crumbling stone archway of the crypts hidden behind a thicket of dead briars.

scenes.outcome: Artie begins to treat the world like a rhythm game.
scenes.summary: Artie enters the Crypts and finds that the skeletons move in predictable, turn-based patterns.
scenes.transition_in_text: The air turns cold as Artie descends the stone stairs.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie steps into the first large hall, his cloak glowing in the dark.

scenes.outcome: Artie navigates the upper crypts to reach the main combat area.
scenes.summary: Artie navigates the dark, moss-covered corridors of the upper crypts, following the rhythmic clicking of bones until the passage opens into a massive chamber.
scenes.transition_in_text: The narrow stone corridor amplifies the sound of his footsteps, forcing him to walk on his tiptoes.
scenes.transition_out_text: The tunnel widens, revealing a cavernous room lit by flickering blue torches.

scenes.outcome: Artie survives his first ranged encounter and gains confidence.
scenes.summary: A Skeleton Archer fires at Artie; the Cloak's evasion procs, causing Artie to do an accidental backflip.
scenes.transition_in_text: A skeletal archer notches a notched arrow in the distance.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie moves deeper into the crypt, toward a room filled with treasure chests.

scenes.outcome: Artie follows the loot trail to the Treasure Room.
scenes.summary: Leaving a trail of shattered porcelain and gold coins behind him, Artie follows a glowing trail of system loot icons deeper into the dungeon.
scenes.transition_in_text: The gold coin fountain slowly fades, leaving a trail of shimmering pixels on the stone floor.
scenes.transition_out_text: He pushes open a set of heavy oak doors, his eyes widening at the glint of gold inside.

scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie discovers he can farm resources much faster than anyone else.
scenes.outcome: Artie discovers he can farm resources much faster than anyone else.
scenes.summary: Artie realizes his crits don't just do damage; they cause 'System Overload' effects like turning enemies into loot-filled pinatas.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie corners a group of skeletons near a large chest.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie hears the sound of heavy boots echoing from the balcony above.

sections.title: The Crypt of Bad Math

sections.end_condition: The boss battle begins with Artie at a massive disadvantage.
sections.intent: Reintroduce Vane as a persistent threat.

scenes.outcome: Artie hides from the incoming high-level party.
scenes.summary: Hearing the heavy, coordinated footsteps of a high-level party, Artie scrambles up a crumbling stone pillar to reach the observation balcony just as Vane enters the room below.
scenes.transition_in_text: The synchronized marching of armored boots sends a spike of panic through Artie's 1 HP chest.
scenes.transition_out_text: He dives behind a dusty stone sarcophagus on the upper tier, holding his breath.

scenes.outcome: Artie sees the gap between a 'proper' build and his own.
scenes.summary: Vane enters the crypts with a full party, clearing rooms with ease while Artie hides in a sarcophagus.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie peers over the edge of a stone sarcophagus.
scenes.transition_out_text: Vane's party leaves the room, leaving a glowing orb on a pedestal.

scenes.outcome: Artie descends to the Guardian Chamber.
scenes.summary: After Vane's party clears out, Artie carefully climbs down from the balcony, his eyes fixed on the pulsing red orb they left behind on the obsidian pedestal.
scenes.transition_in_text: The heavy iron doors slam shut behind Vane's group, plunging the lower chamber into an eerie silence.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie drops down to the main floor, his boots echoing loudly as he approaches the center of the room.

scenes.outcome: Artie decides to take the risk and summon the boss for the massive XP.
scenes.summary: Vane's party leaves behind a 'Boss Trigger'—a rare item that summons a Floor Guardian.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie approaches the obsidian pedestal with a mix of fear and greed.
scenes.transition_out_text: The red orb shatters, and the floor begins to shake violently.

scenes.end_condition_echo: The boss battle begins with Artie at a massive disadvantage.
scenes.outcome: The boss battle begins with Artie at a massive disadvantage.
scenes.summary: The Floor Guardian, a Bone Golem, emerges, and Artie realizes he forgot to check its 'Minimum Damage' stat.
scenes.transition_in_text: The Bone Golem fully forms, its massive shadow engulfing Artie.

sections.title: The Rival's Shadow

chapters.stakes_shift: Survival shifts from luck to tactical exploitation of the System's bugs.
chapters.title: The Glass Cannon's Guide to Not Dying
